about:
First Medical was founded in 1985 by Ed Gogerty and Jim in Urbandale, Iowa. The privately held company began as a supplier of urological products and expanded over the decades to serve a broader healthcare market.

Today the company operates as a distributor of medical and surgical supplies, pharmaceuticals, and equipment. It offers a range of supply-chain services including no-minimum-order purchasing, less-than-case quantities, a private-label program (Quality Choice Physician Network), no-cost initial inventory, par-level ordering, alternative product sourcing during backorders, same-day delivery, 24-hour emergency service, and custom stocking of practice-specific items. A pharmacist is on staff and phones are answered 24/7, even on holidays.

First Medical serves thousands of medical offices, physician practices, retail pharmacies, and home-healthcare providers needing oxygen and enteral products. The company is a member of Independent Medical Co-op Inc., which extends its purchasing reach.

The firm emphasizes competitive pricing and personalized service, highlighting the economical benefits of buying from a Midwestern company. Its founding goal was to provide outstanding service with competitive pricing, a promise it backs with same-day delivery and round-the-clock support.
